dominance_assessment: REV2: unchanged conclusion — two materially independent axes (Evidence Semantics/Composition [SC-2/3/4/5] and Interaction Understanding [SC-1]) plus Response Decision Stability [SC-6]; stage-resolved attribution of SC-6 is itself an instrumentation capability gap.

gaps.statement: The system cannot reliably classify task type from surface form: anchored pattern lists miss common paraphrases, deixis detection substring-matches, and the four-label intent taxonomy has no clarify/escalation path for domain-adjacent or scenario-complete inputs.

Selection exhibits no authoritative-source preference for narrative/troubleshooting phrasing, and the pipeline retains no stage-level visibility (fused vs reranked) that would allow locating selection losses — an instrumentation capability gap in itself.

The evidence set carries no current-vs-historical semantics: historical quotes and current authoritative pages are composed without temporal ordering or marking, and generation receives no machine-enforced currency signal.

The background channel composes identity-bearing internal case documents into generation context with presentation-only visibility control; provenance of the actually-used evidence is invisible to the user, and identity suppression is prompt-level rather than deterministic.
Citation validation verifies numeric presence, not claim-source correspondence or currency, allowing stale claims to acquire legitimate-looking citations to current pages.

Whether a run answers, bound-refuses, or relays background is not stable across equivalent-intent runs; retained evidence shows upstream retrieval variance participates (12/19 split cases with differing source states), so stability requires stage-attributable instrumentation before generation-side decisions can be relied on.
